judgement.impact: The screen-reader user hears only "image" and cannot know about the 50% OFF TODAY promotion that sighted users see.
The user hears only Submit on the payment button and cannot confirm from the button itself that activating it will pay R1,249.
The user cannot know the button deletes/clears payment data and may activate it expecting it to only close something.
Blind user hears 'Total:' with no amount and cannot verify what they will be charged before paying.
The user cannot know the Card number field is flagged as invalid and will attempt to pay with an incorrect value.
When navigating by links the user hears only generic 'Click here' and cannot tell it is the Terms agreement for the payment.
